name: Vegan Aquafaba Meringue Frosting

instructions.primary_message: In a 2-quart saucepan, combine aquafaba with sugar and cardamom. Set over medium-low heat and cook, stirring and scraping with a silicone spatula, until mixture reaches 183°F.

Remove from heat and immediately scrape mixture into the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the whisk. Add the cream of tartar and whisk at high speed until satiny white, stiff peaks form, about 15 minutes.
Frost cakes as desired with the meringue frosting.

schema_metadata.keywords: vegan meringue frosting, aquafaba frosting, aquafaba, cream of tartar, sugar, cardamom

description: An egg-free meringue that'll hold its peaks for hours.
notes:
Notes: Aquafaba is the cooking liquid collected from beans (in this case chickpeas). We recommend using aquafaba from canned chickpeas for reliable and consistent results. Please note that while home-cooked chickpeas can produce aquafaba that works, you may end up with varying results depending on how much water was used to cook the beans and how they were cooked. One 15-ounce can of chickpeas gives about 2/3 cup aquafaba.

Make-ahead and storage: This frosting can be refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 3 days.
author: Nik Sharma
